fn power(base: Int, exp: Int) -> Int
  requires (exp >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * power(base, (exp - 1)))))
  effects pure
  example (power(0, 0) == 1)
  example (power(0, 1) == 0)
{
  if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * power(base, (exp - 1)))
}

fn modp(n: Int, p: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (p > 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result < p)
  ensures (result == (power(2, n) % p))
  effects pure
  example (modp(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
